comments.author: Andy.
comments.html: Dam you Richard Phillips… I read your first three books in the “Second Ship” series as soon as they were available and then purchased the hard copy paperbacks and I took all three paperbacks of the “Once Dead” series on holiday to Crete. I sat on the beach (in the shade) or on the balcony of our room at the Old Phoenix Hotel in Southern Crete and read them cover to cover & back to back in four days… only stopping for snorkeling, food (Some..oh well LOTs of wine & Tsikoudia then) and sleep… I then downloaded the kindle editions of the first two Rho Agenda Assimilation series from the free wifi in the hotel and read them on my iPad…and now I find I have to pace about, holding my head in unrequited expectation of the third book that’s not out for another 8 months… Dam you Mr. Philips for being such a good writer..I’ll have worn out my shoes pacing up and down and have no hair left by then…… Oh… and thank you for being so very very good at what you do… Kind Regards, Andy, Somerset UK.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thank you Andy. Glad to make your life a living hell. By the way, if you would like to become one of my Beta Readers, I will have the initial draft of the third book, The Meridian Ascent available for free to my Beta Readers in early January. If you do, just email me at [email removed]
Best,
Richard
